The journalist must be to the right of the adventure-watcher, so with only two positions the adventure-watcher is in position 1 and the journalist in position 2.  
Since the police‑officer does not share the filmmaking hobby, the filmmaking hobby belongs to the journalist, leaving the police‑officer with the collecting hobby.  
Thus the adventure‑watcher (position 1) is the police‑officer, and the thriller‑watcher (position 2) is the journalist.

<solution>1, filmmaking, police-officer, journalist</solution>
Final answer: 1, filmmaking, police-officer, journalist
